_meta.note: Operating platform narrative from official GHL brand/service descriptions.

platformFields.cap_profile_operational:
In-region Latin America hotel operations across Colombia, Peru, Chile, and Guatemala
Full-service hotels (100+ rooms in GHL category) with restaurants, wet areas, gym, and meeting rooms
Multi-brand operating standards across GHL family, Geotel, and resort labels
Events and celebrations staffing with facilities and advisory support
Destination-led guest experience programs across 18 published destinations
platformFields.cap_profile_commercial:
Direct booking platform with best-price messaging on official site
Leisure plans (weekend, romantic, spa, wedding night) and advance-purchase offers
Meetings and events capability for corporate and social groups
Restaurant and F&B as guest and local demand drivers
Brand-segmented inventory across Style, Relax, Collection, and core GHL
platformFields.cap_profile_transition:
Portfolio growth via brand-family hotels and destination expansion in Latin America
Full-service opening and operating playbooks for urban economic hubs
Events ramp and F&B activation as part of hotel guest services
Confirm takeover/PIP scope in any third-party management agreement (public site is primarily operator-branded inventory)
platformFields.cap_card_asset_positioning: GHL is a Latin America operator-branded platform concentrated in urban and leisure full-service hotels—Colombia-weighted with selective Peru, Chile, and Guatemala presence—not a global third-party scale narrative.
platformFields.cap_card_service_diff: Differentiation comes from proprietary brand families, in-region destination depth, and meetings/events + F&B intensity rather than a remote U.S. management-company model.
platformFields.cap_card_execution_rel: Published portfolio scale and multi-country presence support operating credibility; owners should diligence agreement terms separately because the public site emphasizes branded hotels more than third-party management contracts.
platformFields.cap_card_governance: Public materials do not publish owner-committee structures; treat owner reporting cadence as agreement-defined for any third-party mandate.
platformFields.cap_deep_revenue_systems:
Official direct booking and plan packaging
Leisure and events demand segmentation
Brand-family rate architecture across GHL Style / Relax / Collection / core
Confirm RMS/CRS stack by asset in diligence
platformFields.cap_deep_execution_infra:
In-region hotel operating teams across four countries
Events facilities and professional advisory for celebrations
Full-service amenities (meetings, F&B, wet areas, gym) in GHL category hotels
Multi-brand standards across Geotel and GHL family labels
